title: Chief Executive Order 38 Conduct of General Elections Tenth Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 38 Conduct of General Elections Tenth Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS
CONDUCT OF GENERAL
ELECTIONS
(TENTH AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 38 OF 2002
An Order further to
amend the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
20-11-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
-hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Order may be called the Conduct of General
Elections (Tenth Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 38 Conduct of General Elections Tenth Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of Article 8B, Chief Executive's Order 7 of 2002

CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS
CONDUCT OF GENERAL
ELECTIONS
(TENTH AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 38 OF 2002
An Order further to
amend the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
20-11-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
-hereby published for general information:-
2. Amendment of Article 8B,
Chief Executive's Order 7 of 2002.----- In the Conduct of General Elections
Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's- Order 7 of 2002), hereinafter referred to as
the said Order, in Article 8B, in clause (1), for paragraph (b), the following
shall be substituted, namely:-
"(b) eight shall be elected
from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas, in such manner as the President
may, by Order, prescribe;"
